text:
lena: Quick discovery while auditing migration doc links: the embeddings batch param rename in v2 isn't called out anywhere. v1 used `inputs` (array of strings) and v2 uses `items` and supports mixed `text`/`metadata` objects. We should add a tiny migration note + a sample JS and curl snippet. cc @omar @priyanka

omar: Nice catch. UX risk: customers with simple `inputs` loops will break. Let's show an automated shim example and a one-line guide to migrate: map `inputs => items` with `{text, metadata}` shape. Also add a note about vector dim changes when swapping model families.

lena: I'll draft a short section under docs/guide/migration/embeddings.md titled "Batch param rename and shape changes". Planning minimal examples and a compatibility shim. PR coming.

priyanka: For the example, include both the JS SDK and an HTTP curl example. Also mention the deprecation timeline for `inputs` param and add a banner to the embeddings quickstart.

lena: Draft PR 4222: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4222 00: adds JS + curl examples, migration tip, and a compatibility snippet for batch shims.

omar: Can you paste the proposed JS snippet here so I can sanity-check?

lena: Sureelow:```js
// migrate v1 `inputs: ['a','b']` -> v2 `items: [{text:'a'},{text:'b'}]`
const items = inputs.map(t => ({ text: t }));
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'redwood/embed-128', items });
```

priyanka: For the shim we should show an adapter that accepts old `inputs` and converts to `items` automatically. Small code:```js
function normalizeBatch(body) {
  if (body.inputs) {
    return { ...body, items: body.inputs.map(i => typeof i === 'string' ? { text: i } : i) };
  }
  return body;
}
```

ci-bot: ci-bot: docs/lint checks started for PR 4222

lena: Also noting model family dim change: `embed-128` -> `embed-1536` (different families) can break downstream indexes. I'll add an explicit "vector dimension" callout and link to migration checklist for vector stores.

omar: Good. Add an example of detecting dim mismatch and returning a clear error: e.g., `if (index.dim !== result.vector.length) throw new Error('embedding-dim-mismatch')`.

priyanka: Small editorial ask: use `items` everywhere in examples and mark `inputs` as deprecated with the timeline: "deprecated on 2026-06-01, removed 2026-09-01". I'd like to align the banner deploy with the July docs build.

lena: Will add the deprecation banner snippet and schedule with @docs-bot for a July deploy. Also added cross-link to the SDK changelog for param rename.

ci-bot: ci-bot: docs/lint passed for PR 4222; smoke tests pending

docs-bot: sched: banner-add PR scheduled for 2026-07-05 site build.

lena: OK, assigning reviews to @omar and @priyanka. Once smoke tests complete I'll merge. Anything else to add?

omar: One more: remind SDK owners to add runtime warnings in v2 SDK when callers still pass `inputs` - log a deprecation warning at runtime for one minor release.

priyanka: Agreed. I'll file a follow-up issue for SDK teams.

lena: Thanks all. After merge I'll ping @support to update our migration FAQ and add a short Slack-ready blurb for customers who hit the shim behavior.

docs-bot: update: smoke tests green for PR 4222; ready to merge.
